summary: Bare `sync` (no --resources) must default to every registered flat top-level resource -- currently ["workouts", "classes"]. Any future regen must keep defaultSyncResources() in sync with knownSyncResourceNames()'s flat entries; a fresh print or an added resource that updates one without the other silently reintroduces the no_bulk_list_endpoints no-op.
reason: defaultSyncResources() returned an unconditional empty slice, so bare `sync` always emitted {"reason":"no_bulk_list_endpoints",...} even though workouts and classes were both registered and paginate fine -- whatever marks a resource as a default sync target was never set for either.
